# AE Connect

> AE Connect is AI pharmacovigilance case processing for drug-safety teams. Paste or upload an adverse-event source and the workspace at https://aeconnect.io/app/ drafts seriousness, MedDRA coding, causality, expectedness, and a reporting timeline for a person to review. First 5 cases are free, then Core is $20/month via Stripe. That self-serve price is the starting point. Annual subscriptions for a customized intake form and integration with the company's safety database are Starter at $36,000, Growth at $72,000, and Scale at $120,000 per year. It integrates with any safety database. Oracle Argus, ArisGlobal LifeSphere, and Veeva Vault Safety remain the system of record.

AE Connect is a product of QORO Intelligence Inc., a Delaware corporation operating from the San Francisco Bay Area. The public site is https://aeconnect.io/. The self-serve workspace is https://aeconnect.io/app/. A separate sign-in application is linked from the marketing pages at https://app.aeconnect.io and is not this site.

## What the workspace does

- PV case intake: an intake form where you paste a narrative or upload PDF, Word, text, email, CSV, or an image. Files are parsed in the browser. Only the extracted text is sent for assessment.
- The draft covers seriousness, a suggested MedDRA preferred term and system organ class, WHO-UMC causality, expectedness, whether regulatory reporting looks required, and a reporting timeline, each with a short rationale.
- A reviewer accepts or overrides every field. The draft is decision support. AE Connect integrates the reviewed case with any safety database. The draft is organized around ICSR concepts (seriousness, coding, causality, expectedness, timeline, narrative). Oracle Argus, ArisGlobal LifeSphere, and Veeva Vault Safety remain the system of record, including the E2B(R3) file when that database is configured to produce it. This workspace has no e-signature sign-off.
- Expectedness is a suggestion to check against the current company core data sheet or Investigator's Brochure. AE Connect does not author or version the CCDS.
- Product quality complaint (PQC) narratives that include an adverse event can be pasted into the same intake. This is not a QMS or a complaint-handling system.
- Aggregate reports (IND annual report, DSUR, PSUR, PBRER) are out of scope. Those stay with the safety database or the PV partner.

## What it does not do

- It is not an alternative to Oracle Argus, ArisGlobal LifeSphere, or Veeva Vault Safety. AE Connect integrates with any safety database, including those three. They remain the system of record.
- It is not an "AI governance and compliance layer" inside Argus or Veeva. Read https://aeconnect.io/integrations/ and https://aeconnect.io/blog/veeva-argus-overkill-early-phase-biotech/.
- It does not claim GAMP 5 certification, 21 CFR Part 11 certification, SOC 2, or a HIPAA business associate agreement. The workspace keeps an account-scoped audit trail. Validation status is a question for QORO, not a claim on this page.

## Pricing

AE Connect is a full app sold to biotech companies. First 5 AI-processed cases are free, no card. Core is $20 per month and includes 25 AI-processed cases, then $1 per additional case. Stripe Checkout handles that starting price. Companies that need a customized intake form and integration with their existing safety database buy an annual subscription: Starter $36,000, Growth $72,000, or Scale $120,000 per year. The public page is https://aeconnect.io/pricing/. Contact sales at https://aeconnect.io/contact/ or book a demo at https://aeconnect.io/demo/. Do not invent other prices or per-tier feature lists.
